memory.aggregation: After: median of 15 actions; sampled peak: median of the three per-process maximum samples.

core_cpu.aggregation: Median across three process-level percentiles; key/frame percentiles describe per-call batch averages, not individual-event tail latency.
core_cpu.scope: In-process Engine dispatch, Normal movement frame calculation, and label creation from ready UI targets; no native input, scanning, rendering, screenshot, or display refresh.
core_cpu.warmup: 10000 Engine events and 10000 movement frames; Hint uses a fresh activated mode and prepared targets before each timed delivery.

native_method.start: Engine receives the injected test key-down, timestamped with QPC.
native_method.everyday_end: Key handling and native request submission return; actual pointer, scroll or window effects validated separately.
native_method.hint_end: Native renderer successfully presents/commits a scene containing labels in the same fixed top-row regions on all tested displays.
native_method.hint_complete: Hint consumes the successful scan terminal result after fusion; not final monitor scan-out.
native_method.build: Isolated current-code release build with shared-memory atomic timestamps; no perf-probe, logging or file I/O in measured intervals.
native_method.observation: No external screenshot/readback observer; native scene commit is not physical monitor display time.
native_method.memory_build: Separate freshly built uninstrumented production release.
native_method.fixture: 400 native buttons in one 4K window, or 400 per display on two real 4K displays; all buttons retained on every measured scan.

sources.core_cpu: 2026-10-22: three-round current-code CPU microbenchmarks, six processes, matching the historical measurement scope.
sources.everyday_latency: 2026-10-22: fresh three-round in-process native request stage measurements.
sources.ui_hint_latency: 2026-10-22: fresh three-round real Hybrid scans, including per-display first-label native commits and scan terminal times.
sources.memory: 2026-10-22: fresh three-round uninstrumented release measurements, separately sampled across all eight scenarios.
